title: Hot reload vs live reload
body:
I believe the usage of the term "hot reload" might be misleading, and that "live reload" (or simply watch mode) is more appropriate.      

Hot reload refers to a system able to replace the changed modules in place, keeping the server alive during the process and therefore preserving other module states.  And I don't think TSX watch mode does this. 

Vite-node does provide HMR. Therefore, I was wondering if you considered using vite-node, and if you did, why did you favor tsx ? 

Aside from that, this is project seems to be a great starter ! Thanks, I'll use it for my next side-project !
author: Railore

comments.body:
@Railore Thank you for catching this terminology discrepancy! We've addressed it in #7:

- 📝 Standardized on "live reload" terminology throughout docs
- 🔄 Added clarification about automatic server restarts
- 🛠️ Maintained the original `npm run dev` command

Regarding `vite-node`: We've documented our evaluation in the PR discussion (#7) and concluded that tsx remains the better choice for:
1. Server-side development simplicity
2. Stability with current architecture
3. Minimal config requirements

If you'd like to explore a `vite-node` implementation, please feel free to open a new enhancement request!

Closing this as resolved. 🎉
